evals.prompt: /audit-all on a single Next.js app with no Redis, no Firestore and no Storybook. Every fe and be audit is installed.
evals.expected_output: Should detect the scope and run only the audits that apply, reading each audit's SKILL.md by path, one parallel task each where the agent can run them. Redis, Firestore and Storybook audits are listed as skipped with the reason. Should write _reports/audit-all.md with the roll-up and change no code.
expectations: Runs each applicable audit by reading its SKILL.md by path

evals.prompt: api-audit and access-control-audit both report the same missing guard on POST /api/v1/invites. How does the roll-up show it?
evals.expected_output: Should report it once in the cross-cutting priorities, naming both audits, rather than counting it twice.
expectations: Doesn't double-count it in the summary

evals.prompt: Run audit-all, then fix the top three priorities and commit them.
evals.expected_output: Should run the audits and write the roll-up, but never change code: the audits are report-only, fixing is a separate request, and nothing is committed or pushed without explicit approval.
expectations: Runs the suite and writes the report
Doesn't fix anything during the audit
Explains fixing is a separate request
